author: Teelekonline

title: Show repeat, reminder and goal.
body: It'd be much better if I could see all habit details at a click and glance . Displaying Repeat, Reminders, and Goals right at the beginning, before progress, would help understand the habit's purpose without the need for multiple clicks. The current process, involving clicking habit, then three dots, then edit, makes it cumbersome for scheduling. Also, some features, like action manage list, appear redundant with tasks in the about page. Simplifying these steps would greatly improve the user experience. Every time it synced to Google calendar same task will duplicate itself again and again unlink with apple calendar, no duplicated tasks created.

title: Life changing
body:
Firstly, I’ll just say that I am VERY selective with the apps I install.
Habitify is one app that’s staying for good though- instead of relying on fleeting moments of motivation, habitify has systemised the important parts of my business and personal life.
It’s simple to use and super handy to have across my devices. Great support from inside the app too. 5 stars fosho
